 The case for it
 Why SeaFlower is different
 Three things that are true here and not true of most new communities on the Gulf Coast.

 A village, not a subdivision
 Narrow streets, porches on the sidewalk, garages in the alley, pocket parks, and a 2.5-mile trail you can ride a golf cart on to a Publix. It is traditional neighborhood design on Florida's coastal mainland.

 An ADU on every single-family lot
 Garage apartments and detached casitas are allowed on every single-family homesite, an unusual county approval. That means a guest suite, a home office, or a rental income line, with a one-year owner-occupancy rule before renting.

 Three miles from the Gulf
 Anna Maria Island and Bradenton Beach are a short drive, Longboat Key under ten miles, Sarasota and Tampa within an hour, and IMG Academy is next door.

 FAQ
 Questions buyers ask first

 Do I need a buyer's agent to buy new construction in SeaFlower? You are allowed to buy without one, but the builder's sales consultant works for the builder. A buyer's agent costs you nothing extra on new construction because the builder pays the commission, and the agent negotiates incentives, reviews the contract and walks the build. Most builders require your agent to register you before or at your first visit, so call before you tour.

 How much are the HOA and CDD fees at SeaFlower? The HOA is $300.88 a month for a single-family home ($308.43 townhome, $327.70 villa) and includes 1-Gig fiber and yard maintenance. The Lake Flores CDD adds roughly $1,475 to $4,605 a year depending on phase and lot width, billed on the tax bill. Full tables are on the costs page.

 How far is SeaFlower from the beach? The developer's site plan measures 3.2 miles to the beach. Bradenton Beach is about an 8-minute drive, Coquina Beach about 12, and Longboat Key about 18, per Cardel's published drive times.

 Which builders are in SeaFlower and what do homes cost? M/I Homes (townhomes and villas from $399,999), Pulte (from $404,990), David Weekley (Bungalow homes from the $500s, Classic from the $600s), Cardel (from the $500s) and Issa Homes (estate homes from $1,250,000 excluding homesite premium), as published in September 2026.

 Is SeaFlower gated or age-restricted? Neither. No gates appear on the site plan and streets are being turned over to Manatee County as public roads. It is an all-ages community.

# SeaFlower Bradenton Community Guide: Master Plan, Amenities, Village Center and Rules

URL: https://buyinginseaflower.com/community/
What SeaFlower in Bradenton actually is: 1,175 acres, 1,063 Phase One homes, The Garden Club opening fall 2026, the Lake Flores golf-cart trail, the Publix-anchored Village Center, plus rules on gates, golf carts, ADUs and rentals. Verified Sept 2026.

Home 
 Community

 The community

 SeaFlower, explained: a coastal village three miles from the Gulf 

 SeaFlower® is a 1,175-acre master-planned coastal village in west Bradenton, Manatee County, Florida (ZIP 34210), south of Cortez Road West and west of 75th Street West, about three miles from Anna Maria Island.
 Lake Flores Land Company is developing it on the former Preston family flower farm. Phase One covers 400 acres with 1,063 homes from five builders, a resident-only amenity campus called The Garden Club, a 2.5-mile golf-cart trail around the 19-acre Lake Flores, and a Publix-anchored Village Center with apartments and a hotel. Full buildout is planned at about 4,000 homes.

 Updated September 3, 2026 Welcome Center: 4505 Flower Fields Trail, Bradenton, FL 34210 · (941) 212-0801

 The story behind the name

 For nearly 90 years the Preston family grew flowers here, mostly gladiolus, under the Manatee Fruit Company name. When farming stopped being viable in the early 2000s the family began planning something else for the land. Manatee County approved the plan in 2015 under the working name Lake Flores, a nod to Whiting Preston's mother, Flavia Florez Preston. The community was renamed SeaFlower before launch to tie the flower history to its position on the coastal mainland near Sarasota Bay.

 The developer is Lake Flores Land Company, led by principal Ed Hill, with LAMB Properties as investment partner. Walter Preston still sits on the community development district board. The Welcome Center at 4505 Flower Fields Trail is itself a Cardel-built home with an 800-square-foot accessory dwelling unit, which tells you a lot about the design intent.

 What "coastal village" actually means

 SeaFlower is heavily influenced by traditional neighborhood design without being a strict TND. In practice that means narrower streets designed for slower traffic, front porches close to the sidewalk, garages pushed to the rear on alleys for many products, pocket parks within a short walk, and a mixed-use center you can reach by golf cart. Four architectural styles are permitted: Coastal, West Indies, Craftsman and Transitional Farmhouse, in a palette of whites with warm accents.

 Every single-family homesite is allowed an accessory dwelling unit, either a garage apartment or a detached casita connected by a breezeway. That is unusual for a Florida master plan and it changes the math for buyers who want a separate suite for guests, an office, or a rental income line.

 Trent’s take
 Rear-load garages are why the streets photograph so well: the street side is porches and windows, not garage doors. They also mean your driveway is in the alley. Bring your longest vehicle to the model and check the turning radius before you fall in love with a 42-foot lot.

 Master plan and phases

 Phase One around Lake Flores, looking west to the Gulf (rendering courtesy of the developer) 
 Phase One is 1,063 homes in four sub-phases around Lake Flores. As of April 2026, 784 of those homesites had been released, with 400 lots finished and 384 more under construction through 2026. Phase Two is expected to start around 2027.

 Trent's take
 Ask which phase your lot sits in before you sign. It changes your CDD line by more than $1,500 a year between Phase 1B2 and Phase 1C on the same 50-foot lot, and it tells you whether the streets around you are finished or still a construction zone. The best premium lots in each release, lake, park and corner, go in the first few weeks.

 Full buildout: about 4,000 homes, 600 apartments, 250 hotel rooms and 350,000 sq ft of retail and office.

 The Garden Club, Lake Flores and the trail

 The Garden Club resort pool on Lake Flores The fitness center Plumeria Hall, the resident lounge The Gathering Hall for events and clubs Fitness studio opening onto the lawn 
 Renderings and photos courtesy of the developer and builders; final construction may differ.

 The Garden Club is the resident-only amenity campus designed by LRK on the shore of the 25-acre Lake Flores Park. It broke ground July 9, 2025 and is scheduled to open in fall 2026. An Art of Living Director programs the calendar.

 Plumeria Hall
 Social lounge, demonstration and catering kitchen, conference room for remote work, covered veranda on three sides. Home base for the Art of Living Director who programs the events calendar.

 Gathering Hall
 Indoor-outdoor event hall for clubs, celebrations and HOA meetings, with catering kitchen and outdoor barbecue area.

 Fitness Center
 Workout equipment, a virtual fitness studio, a dedicated studio for classes and a lawn for outdoor yoga; a kids' activity center is also listed.

 Resort pool and Bath House
 Zero-entry pool with lap lanes, sun shelves, covered cabanas, outdoor summer kitchen and spa.

 Courts, lawn and play
 Four pickleball courts, event lawn and amphitheater with a food-truck area, community fire pit and a children's playground.

 Around it: the 19-acre Lake Flores inside the 25-acre Lake Flores Park, the 2.5-mile multi-modal Lake Flores Trail for walking, biking and golf carts, a nature trail through the wetland and upland preserves, two dog parks, pocket parks and a village green. The trail is maintained by the community development district; the Garden Club by the HOA.

 Fee note
 The clubhouse portion of the HOA assessment is abated until The Garden Club is substantially complete. Budget for the monthly fee to step up after opening. Details on the costs and fees page .

 SeaFlower Village Center

 The event lawn at dusk (rendering courtesy of the developer) 
 About 47 acres; roughly 140,000 sq ft of retail, dining and office in phase one (161,500 sq ft total leasable planned), developed by CASTO and Redstone Investments (their third partnership); apartments by Bradenton's NDC Development. Anchored by Publix (about 50,000 sq ft) with a separate Publix Liquors, opening fall 2026. Groundbreaking September 2025; completion targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026.

 Publix and Publix Liquors Dutch Bros Coffee (first in Manatee County) Whataburger Playa Bowls Potbelly Sandwich Works Dave's Hot Chicken Pecan Jacks Nothing Bundt Cakes PacDental / PDS Health Club Pilates Well Groomed Pets Glitz Nail Salon and Boutique Men's Luxe Barbershop PNC Bank Suncoast Credit Union Degree Wellness 

 Also planned: 332 to 362 apartments (developer and CASTO figures differ); 120-room hotel in phase one (brand not announced); 250 rooms at buildout. Tenant list as announced by the developer and CASTO; openings are staggered.

 About 2027 Phase Two expected to begin, timing dependent on market conditions. 

 Rules people ask about

 Is it gated? No gates appear on the site plan or in any developer material; streets are being turned over to Manatee County as public roads.

 Is there an age restriction? No. SeaFlower is an all-ages community marketed for every stage of life.

 Are golf carts allowed? The Lake Flores Trail is designed for golf carts and the developer calls the community golf-cart-friendly. Rules for carts on the public streets follow Florida low-speed-vehicle law; confirm with the HOA before you buy a cart.

 Can I add or rent an ADU? Every single-family homesite is permitted to add an accessory dwelling unit (garage apartment or detached casita). To rent an ADU, the owner must occupy the main home for one year first, and leases must be at least six months.

 Can I rent the whole house? Whole-home leasing rules are in the HOA covenants (a third-party blog claims one year of owner occupancy before leasing; not confirmed in official documents). Ask for the CC&Rs before contract.

 What about pets? No published pet rules were found. Two dog parks are planned. Ask for the HOA covenants before contract.

 Trent's take
 Roughly 200 contracts in six months across five builders is a healthy pace for a community that is still building its amenity center. It is not a frenzy. That matters for you: builders here are competing with each other for the same buyer, which is exactly the environment where incentives and lot-premium negotiations happen. See homes and pricing .

# SeaFlower Location: Distance to Anna Maria Island, Schools, Airports, Flood Zone and Drive Times

URL: https://buyinginseaflower.com/location/
SeaFlower is in west Bradenton 34210, 3.2 miles from the beach, 18 minutes from SRQ and 65 from Tampa. Drive times to beaches, hospitals and shopping, zoned schools (Sea Breeze, Sugg or Electa Lee, Bayshore), the FEMA flood zone, evacuation levels and the honest Cortez Road traffic note.

Home 
 Location

 Location and the area

 Where SeaFlower is, and what is around it 

 SeaFlower is in west Bradenton, Florida 34210, on the coastal mainland of Manatee County, about 3.2 miles from the beach at Anna Maria Island.
 It sits south of Cortez Road West and west of 75th Street West, 8 miles from Sarasota-Bradenton airport, 13 miles from downtown Sarasota and 37 miles from Tampa International. IMG Academy is next door. FEMA maps the interior of the site as Zone X. Zoned schools are Sea Breeze Elementary, W.D. Sugg or Electa Lee Middle, and Bayshore High.

 What west Bradenton is, and is not

 West Bradenton is the older, established side of Manatee County: the Cortez fishing village and its restaurants at the foot of the bridge, the causeway to Anna Maria Island, Palma Sola Bay, the Robinson Preserve trails, IMG Academy, spring-training baseball at LECOM Park and a downtown Riverwalk on the Manatee River. It is not the manicured, everything-new landscape of Lakewood Ranch, and until SeaFlower it had almost no new construction. That contrast is most of why SeaFlower is selling: new homes on the beach side of the county.

 Beaches and the honest traffic note

 The developer's site plan measures 3.2 miles to the beach and every builder quotes a short drive: Bradenton Beach in about 8 minutes, Coquina Beach in 12, Longboat Key in 18. All true, off-peak. Cortez Road is the only bridge road to Anna Maria Island, and in season, mid-February through mid-April with March the worst, beach traffic backs up. Locals go before 10 a.m. or after 1:30 p.m. The Cortez bridge replacement is a pending state project, which will help eventually and hurt during construction.

 Trent’s take
 I timed it for the community video: on a weekday morning it is a ten-minute drive to the sand, and on a Saturday in March it is not. If a beach commute is your daily routine, drive it at the worst time before you buy, then decide. Most buyers here go early, stay late, and come home on the trail.

 Schools

 Manatee County assigns schools by address, and the builders do not agree on the middle school, so confirm the zone with the district locator before you rely on it.

 School Grades Address Listed by 
 Sea Breeze Elementary PK–5 3601 71st St W every builder 
 W. D. Sugg Middle 6–8 5602 38th Ave W Pulte, Cardel 
 Electa Lee Magnet Middle 6–8 4000 53rd Ave W David Weekley 
 Bayshore High 9–12 5401 34th St W every builder 

 Third-party ratings for these schools are modest (GreatSchools scored Sea Breeze 4 of 10 and the middle and high schools 2 of 10 in September 2026). Manatee County offers school choice and magnet programs, and the private options within a short drive are strong: IMG Academy next door, Bradenton Christian, Saint Stephen's Episcopal, St. Joseph Catholic and Cardinal Mooney. This is the question I get most from relocating buyers with school-age children, and the honest answer is that most of them choose a magnet, charter or private school.

 Healthcare

 HCA Florida Blake Hospital is about eight minutes away. Manatee Memorial is about sixteen, Sarasota Memorial about twenty-five, and Tampa General and Moffitt roughly an hour and ten. Dental and urgent care are among the announced Village Center tenants.

 Shopping and dining

 Until the Village Center opens, everyday retail is on Cortez Road and Manatee Avenue West, including the nearest Publix. The Village Center brings a Publix and Publix Liquors, Dutch Bros, Whataburger, Playa Bowls, Potbelly, Dave's Hot Chicken and a dozen more announced tenants, targeted for late 2026. For a night out, Cortez and Bridge Street are ten minutes, downtown Bradenton sixteen, downtown Sarasota and St. Armands about half an hour.

 Getting around

 Sarasota-Bradenton International (SRQ) is about 18 minutes and serves most of the country nonstop in season. Tampa International is about 65 minutes and St. Pete-Clearwater about 55. Inside the community, the 2.5-mile Lake Flores Trail connects the neighborhoods to The Garden Club and the Village Center for walkers, cyclists and golf carts; internal streets are public county roads.

 Flood zone, evacuation level and elevation

 Three separate things, often confused. The FEMA flood zone determines whether a lender requires flood insurance: FEMA's flood hazard layer shows the interior of SeaFlower as Zone X, minimal hazard, with coastal AE and VE zones west of 86th Street toward Palma Sola Bay and small Zone A pockets near 75th Street. The county evacuation level (A through E) determines who is told to leave ahead of a surge event, and is looked up by address on Manatee County's Learn Your Level map. Elevation is on the elevation certificate for a finished home. Ask for all three for your specific lot; a community-wide answer is not good enough.

 Property taxes and insurance

 SeaFlower is in the Cedar Hammock Fire Control District tax district of unincorporated Manatee County, which adopted a total rate of 14.61 mills for 2025. Homeowner's insurance on new construction benefits from the wind-mitigation credits Florida requires insurers to give for current-code homes. The full math, with worked examples, is on the costs and fees page .

 0:28 3 miles to Anna Maria Island. Bikeable. Golf-cart friendly. This is SeaFlower 

 Location questions

 How far is SeaFlower from Anna Maria Island? About 3.2 miles to the beach per the developer's site plan, roughly 8 minutes to Bradenton Beach and 7.2 road miles to Anna Maria Island per builder drive times, off-peak. In season, Cortez Road beach traffic can stretch that considerably.

 What schools are zoned for SeaFlower? Sea Breeze Elementary and Bayshore High per every builder. The middle school is listed as W.D. Sugg by Pulte and Cardel and as Electa Lee Magnet Middle by David Weekley; confirm with the Manatee County School District locator.

 Is SeaFlower in a flood zone? FEMA's flood hazard layer shows the interior of the site as Zone X, minimal flood hazard, with coastal AE and VE zones west of 86th Street and small Zone A pockets near the 75th Street edge. Confirm your specific lot on the county flood map.

 How far is SeaFlower from the airport? Sarasota-Bradenton International (SRQ) is about 18 minutes and 8 miles. Tampa International is about 65 minutes and 37 miles; St. Pete-Clearwater about 55 minutes.

 Which hospital is closest to SeaFlower? HCA Florida Blake Hospital, about 8 minutes away. Manatee Memorial is about 16 minutes and Sarasota Memorial about 25.

 How I would choose

 Start with the monthly number, not the base price. Lot phase changes the CDD, product type changes the HOA, and lender tie-ins change the rate. Two homes with the same sticker can differ by $300 a month. The costs page has the math.
 Pick the lot type before the builder. Rear-load 42' and 45' lots put porches on the street and driveways in the alley. 50' and 60' lots give you a yard and a front garage option. 80' lots are lakefront and semi-custom. The lot decides which two or three builders you are really choosing between.
 Decide whether time or price matters more. Quick move-ins close in 30 to 120 days and carry the biggest discounts and rate buydowns. To-be-built homes get you the lot and the finishes you want, at base price plus options, six to fourteen months out.
 Ask what the builder is proud of. Weekley talks warranty and energy testing. Cardel talks design and the garage suite. Pulte talks price and process. M/I talks inventory and the lock-and-leave HOA. Issa talks the lake. They are all right about themselves.
 Negotiate the things that are actually negotiable. Closing-cost credits through the affiliated lender, design-center credits, lot premiums on slower-moving lots, structural option pricing, and appraisal-gap language. Base price moves least, and moves last.

 Not sure which builder?
 Tell me your budget, timeline and how you plan to live in the home. I will tell you which two to tour and why.

 FAQ
 Builder questions, answered

 Which SeaFlower builder is the least expensive? M/I Homes, with townhomes and twin villas priced from $399,999, followed closely by Pulte's Scenic series from $404,990. Both are attached or compact detached products; the least expensive detached single-family homes are Pulte's.

 Which builder has the most expensive homes? Issa Homes. Its estate homes on 80-foot lakefront lots start from $1,250,000 excluding the homesite premium, and its quick move-in homes were listed above $1.5 million in September 2026.

 Who builds townhomes and villas in SeaFlower? Only M/I Homes. Its Row Homes are townhomes and its Village Homes are twin villas, together 158 units in Phase N1. Every other builder builds detached single-family homes.

 Which builders offer an ADU or garage apartment? Cardel offers garage suites on many plans, Pulte's Front Porch series includes an ADU version of the Mabel II, and Issa offers garage-apartment versions of two plans. David Weekley's ADU availability at SeaFlower is not published. Every single-family lot in SeaFlower is zoned to allow one.

 Can I use my own agent with every builder? Yes. All five builders cooperate with buyer's agents and the builder pays the commission. The catch is registration: most builders require the agent to accompany you or register you before your first visit. Call me before you tour and it is handled.

 Trent’s take

 Trent's take
 M/I is the entry ticket to SeaFlower and, right now, the builder with the most standing inventory. Townhomes and twin villas from $399,999, rear-load detached garages, and a long list of quick move-ins carrying "was" prices. Inventory carrying cost is leverage; a builder with twenty finished or nearly finished homes is a builder that negotiates. The attached-product HOA is a little higher because it covers exterior maintenance and insurance, which is exactly what a lock-and-leave buyer wants to pay for. Watch the advertised FHA rate offers: they are real, but they apply to specific homes and specific closing windows, and the APR is the number that matters.

 Trent's take
 Published incentives are the floor. The real conversation is about lot premium, closing-cost credits tied to the lender, design-center credits and structural options, and it happens with the sales manager, not the website. Timing matters: builders push hardest at the end of their fiscal quarters.

 Watch-outs

 "Priced from: $399,999" is a quick move-in price; the lowest to-be-built plan starts at $404,999 (Ruby villa) and townhome plans at $431,999, and the October 2025 "high $300s" press-release pricing is stale.
 The Summer Savings menu applies only to contracts written by September 15, 2026, the closing-cost and FHA-rate options require M/I Financial, and the offers cannot be combined.
 HOA dues and any CDD are not published by M/I — the only figure is Jome's third-party "$264+/quarterly" — so confirm dues, what they cover, and any villa/townhome sub-associations from the HOA documents before contract.
 "Was" markdowns of $15k–$72k on the 21 specs signal negotiable inventory but also volatility in comps and appraisals; six earlier listings had already disappeared (sold or under contract).
 M/I's own pages disagree on square footage (Carmel 1,694 vs. 1,702; Bay Harbor 1,698 vs. 1,706), and the Sarasota division's Birdeye rating is 3.7 stars with workmanship and warranty complaints (none SeaFlower-specific).

 Schools as listed by the builder

 Jome lists Sea Breeze Elementary (1.1 mi), "Just For Girls Middle School" (1.6 mi) and Bayshore High School (3.2 mi) as nearest schools for the M/I address; Just For Girls is a single-gender academy, not a zoned public middle school, so Jome's nearest-school data is unreliable — official Manatee County zoning for 34210 is unverified (source: Jome, updated 2026-09-03)

 Builders disagree on the middle school. Confirm the assigned zone for a specific address with the Manatee County School District locator before you rely on it. IMG Academy is adjacent to the community.

# Pulte Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)

URL: https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/pulte-homes/
Pulte Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: $404,990+. 13 floor plans, 1,405–2,369 sq ft, 6 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.

Home 
 Builders 
 Pulte Homes

 Builder profile · Entry tier

 Pulte Homes at SeaFlower: plans, prices and what to know before you sign 

 Pulte Homes builds Single-family in the Scenic, Veranda and Distinctive series in SeaFlower, from $404,990.
 13 floor plans on 42' to 50' lots, 1,405–2,369+ square feet, 2–5 bedrooms, 6 quick move-in homes listed. Sales office at 7634 Addison Avenue. Verified Sep 3, 2026.

 Updated Sep 3, 2026 Builder’s SeaFlower page 

 Independent buyer’s guide, not the developer’s or any builder’s site. Figures are as published on the dates noted and must be verified with the builder. Developer’s official site . Builder names are used to identify the builder only; plan and price data are quoted from the builder's public pages and belong to the builder.

 Trent’s take

 Trent's take
 I sold for Pulte for six years, so I will be blunt: this is the value engine of the community. The Scenic series is the lowest entry into a detached home here, the Veranda and Front Porch series add the porches and the ADU option that make SeaFlower feel like SeaFlower, and the Distinctive series is where the bigger single-story plans live. Pulte's published "savings" on quick move-ins are a starting point, not a ceiling. Pulte moves most on price and incentives in the last two weeks of a quarter, and division leadership can approve things the on-site rep cannot ask for. Run the affiliated-lender math against an outside quote every time.

 Before your first visit
 If you plan to visit a model, tell me first. Builders register the agent who introduces you, and some will not let you add representation after a first unaccompanied visit. A five-minute call protects your options; it costs nothing.

 Active Builder Forward Commitment (BFC) rate program via Pulte Mortgage (as of 2026-09-03) 
 Pulte's disclaimer: BFC rates are "offered through Pulte Mortgage LLC, seller's affiliated lender, to lock in an interest rate for a pool of funds ... only available to qualified borrowers buying certain homes until the pool of funds is depleted or the rate lock period expires. The BFC rate is limited to new home agreements only and the sale must close by a specified date (see sales associate for detai source

Eligible buyers shall receive a standard pool, valued at $69,500." Expired; never confirmed as applying to SeaFlower. source 

 Trent's take
 Published incentives are the floor. The real conversation is about lot premium, closing-cost credits tied to the lender, design-center credits and structural options, and it happens with the sales manager, not the website. Timing matters: builders push hardest at the end of their fiscal quarters.

 Fees as quoted by the builder

 Item As quoted 
 HOA (as quoted by builder) Not listed by Pulte. Third-party aggregator Jome shows "$899.34+/quarterly," managed by Castle Management Group, covering grounds maintenance and security — unverified against the builder/developer. 
 CDD (as quoted by builder) unverified (no CDD information found on pulte.com or seaflower.com) 
 Tax rate (as quoted) unverified 

 Pulte's payment estimates exclude taxes, insurance and monthly homeowners' association dues. Developer HOA rule for ADUs: owners must occupy the primary residence for one year before renting the ADU, with a six-month minimum lease (WUSF, 2026-02-05). Capital contribution: unverified. Full HOA and CDD tables by phase and lot are on the costs and fees page .

 Warranty, lender, design center and construction

 Program Details 
 Warranty Homeowner's Limited Warranty Program: workmanship and materials 1 year; leak protection 5 years; structural integrity 10 years (footings, bearing walls, beams, girders, trusses, rafters, bearing columns, lintels, posts, structural fasteners, subfloors, roof sheathing). Transferable to a subsequent owner who takes title within the warranty period. Vendor warranties: Bryant, Moen, Whirlpool, Carrier. A 2-year mechanical-systems tier appears in Pulte's national warranty FAQ but not on the SeaFlower plan-page list — unverified for this community. 
 Energy / construction HERS-rated; every plan page shows "Estimated Annual Energy Savings vs. 20-Year Old Resale Home." Whole-house impact-resistant High Velocity Hurricane Zone-rated Low-E windows, R-30 ceiling insulation, insulated fiberglass entry door, central A/C with fresh-air ventilator and wi-fi programmable thermostat, energy-efficient tankless gas water heater, LED lighting throughout. Pulte cites Florida Green Building Coalition (FGBC) 2023 Builder of the Year for the most certified single-family homes. 
 Structure Steel-reinforced concrete block construction; professionally engineered roof trusses with hurricane tie-downs; tile roof; decorative stucco exterior with ventilated aluminum soffits and whole-house gutters; whole-house impact-resistant HVHZ-rated windows; "Tubes-In-The-Wall" pest defense; Sherwin-Williams latex paint. 
 ADU / casita option Pulte offers the "Mabel II with ADU" plan ($641,990, 5 bed / 4 bath, 2 story, Front Porch collection): the 4-bed / 3-bath Mabel II plus an additional dwelling unit with bedroom and bathroom (ADU square footage not stated). SeaFlower received special ADU zoning permission from Manatee County in 2015; the developer HOA requires one year of owner occupancy before the ADU may be rented and a six-month minimum lease (WUSF, 2026-02-05). 
 Design center Plan pages reference visiting "a Pulte Design Center" and QMI cards link to "See All Design Selections"; the Sarasota-division design center location and the allowance/selection process are unverified. 
 Affiliated lender Pulte Mortgage LLC (NMLS 1791), seller's affiliated lender — 6900 E Layton Ave, Suite 1500, Denver, CO 80237, (800) 426-8898. Pulte: "You are not required to finance through Pulte Mortgage to purchase a home from seller; but use of Pulte Mortgage is necessary to receive BFC-related rate offers where and when available." Affiliated title company: PGP Title (whether it is required for SeaFlower incentives is unverified). 
 Build timeline No to-be-built construction timeline is stated on pulte.com for SeaFlower. Current quick move-ins show anticipated completions of Oct 2026, Nov 2026 and Jan 2027. 

 What stands out
 Steel-reinforced concrete block construction
 Tile roof with hurricane tie-down trusses
 Whole-house impact-resistant (HVHZ) Low-E windows
 Tankless gas water heater and gas range
 Smart Home prewire with CAT 6 and video doorbell
 Brick paver driveway and screened brick paver lanai
 Sensa/Silestone counters, Aristokraft cabinets, Whirlpool appliances
 HERS-rated energy efficiency

 Watch-outs

 HOA dues and any CDD are not published by Pulte; the "$899.34+/quarterly" figure comes from a third-party aggregator — confirm dues, CDD and any capital contribution with the sales team before contracting.
 Builder Forward Commitment rate offers require financing through Pulte Mortgage and closing by a specified date; you are not required to use Pulte Mortgage to buy, and the advertised rates assume a 780 FICO.
 All six quick move-ins are still under construction (anticipated completions Oct 2026–Jan 2027) — none is move-in ready — and Pulte's illustrative monthly payments exclude taxes, insurance and HOA dues.
 Prices are moving: seaflower.com quoted a $399,990 "from" price in March 2026 versus $404,990 on pulte.com today, and three QMIs were just cut $10,000–$10,500 — re-check pulte.com before relying on any figure.
 If you plan to rent the ADU on a Mabel II with ADU, the developer HOA requires one year of owner occupancy first and a six-month minimum lease.

 Schools as listed by the builder

 Not listed on the builder's page. See the location guide for zoned schools.

 Builders disagree on the middle school. Confirm the assigned zone for a specific address with the Manatee County School District locator before you rely on it. IMG Academy is adjacent to the community.

 David Weekley Homes at SeaFlower: plans, prices and what to know before you sign

 Trent’s take

 Trent's take
 I ran operations for this builder and did the final quality walk on homes before they were handed to buyers, so I know what a good Weekley build looks like. The Bungalow collection is the most photogenic product in SeaFlower: rear-load garages, porches on the street, one- and two-story plans on 45-foot lots. The Classic collection is all single-story plans with optional bonus rooms, up to a four-car garage on the Colston. Two things to know. Weekley's September 7% promotion explicitly excludes SeaFlower, which tells you this community is selling without help; ask about lot-specific and design-center credits instead. And Grace Home Lending is 75% owned by the builder, so compare its offer with an outside lender before you decide.

 Trent's take
 Published incentives are the floor. The real conversation is about lot premium, closing-cost credits tied to the lender, design-center credits and structural options, and it happens with the sales manager, not the website. Timing matters: builders push hardest at the end of their fiscal quarters.

 Fees as quoted by the builder

 Item As quoted 
 HOA (as quoted by builder) SeaFlower Homeowners Association $300.88 per month includes front and rear lawn maintenance. Excludes amenity fees. 
 CDD (as quoted by builder) $2,095.84 per year (Bungalow Homes page); $2,660.36 per year (Classic Homes page) 
 Tax rate (as quoted) Taxes: 14.671 (millage as shown on DWH's pages). Verifier note: 14.6710 is Manatee County's 2024 millage for tax district 0302 (Cedar Hammock Fire Control); the 2025 adopted rate is 14.6100 and the 2026 proposed rate is 14.5666. 

 DWH's figures are primary. Third-party listing site Jome (Sept 3, 2026) shows different numbers — HOA $299.78/month (ICON Management), CDD $1,853.56/yr (Bungalow) and $2,337.31+/yr (Classic), tax rate 1.47%+. DWH's 14.671 millage is the 2024 figure, not current, and SeaFlower's membership in tax district 0302 is inferred only from that match. Confirm current HOA and CDD assessments with the sales office.  Warranty, lender, design center and construction

 Program Details 
 Warranty Multi-level 1-2-10 warranty: Year 1 — 'David Weekley Homes one-year limited warranty, plus the appliance manufacturers' warranties'; Years 1–2 — mechanical systems ('plumbing, electrical, central air conditioning and heating systems'); Years 1–10 — 'major structural defects' ('foundation, columns and load-bearing walls'). Each homeowner gets a personal Warranty Service Representative (the Home Team also includes a dedicated Warranty Service Manager). Tampa warranty contact: TWarranty@dwhomes.com, 813-422-6136, after hours 813-422-6199. Transferability and exclusions are not stated on the page. 
 Energy / construction EnergySaver homes: DWH Tampa homes average a 71 on the HERS Index and are 'on average 29% more energy efficient than a home built in 2006.' Program features (corporate page): Low-E windows; formaldehyde-free insulation with fresh-air ventilation; low/zero-VOC paint, carpet and wood products; cement-based backer on shower/tub walls; advanced air sealing; right-sized HVAC; jump ducts / pressure balancing; duct blaster test (leakage ≤3% before drywall); blower-door test; third-party inspections of insulation, thermal envelope and ductwork before drywall; Environments For Living heating/cooling energy-use guarantee certificate at closing (all-electric homes may not qualify). 
 Structure unverified — concrete-block construction, impact-rated glass, finished-floor elevation and flood-zone status are not stated on any DWH SeaFlower page. Natural gas service (TECO Peoples Gas) is listed for the community; plan marketing mentions 'energy-efficient windows' and 'expansive sliding glass doors'. 
 ADU / casita option SeaFlower permits accessory dwelling units (owner must occupy the primary residence one year before renting; six-month minimum lease per the HOA), but whether David Weekley offers an ADU or garage-apartment option at SeaFlower is unverified. 
 Design center Tampa Design Center, 9006 Brittany Way, Tampa, FL 33619, 813-422-6150: buyers 'browse through a variety of Custom Choices™ with the help of a professional Design Consultant'; options are pre-priced ('Cabinets, countertops, appliances and more – it's all under one roof'); 'Preview Night' events mentioned; hours not published. MyDWH.com wish-list site before appointments; most selections are finalized before construction because 'materials are ordered early in the build process.' A SeaFlower-specific included-features list was not found — unverified. 
 Affiliated lender Preferred lender Grace Home Lending (prequalify at https://www.houseloan.com/ghltampa/; contact named on DWH's Tampa financing page: Tori Messina). Disclosure: David Weekley Homes 'has a 75% ownership interest in Grace Home Lending, LLC' and 'you are not required to use Grace Home Lending as a condition for purchase of a home from David Weekley Homes.' DWH's FAQ says buyers can use any lender but preferred lenders offer 'added convenience, a more streamlined process and potentially access to special incentives.' No title-company requirement is stated. 
 Build timeline DWH's FAQ: 'most new homes take several months from the start of construction to completion,' with the home team providing estimated timelines early; buyers meet their Personal Builder at the Pre-Construction Meeting, with a pre-drywall walk and final orientation. Quick move-in 'Ready' dates observed on 2026-09-03 run from 10/14/2026 to 1/25/2027, i.e., homes now under construction are scheduled roughly 1.5–5 months out.

 Watch-outs

 The only active DWH promotion in September 2026 (7% off base price 'Special Employee Discount Event', max $40,000) explicitly excludes SeaFlower, and no SeaFlower-specific rate buydown, flex cash or closing-cost credit is published — ask the on-site team.
 DWH's 'Taxes: 14.671' is Manatee County's 2024 millage; the 2025 adopted rate is 14.6100 and the 2026 proposed rate is 14.5666. HOA/CDD figures also differ between DWH ($300.88/mo; $2,095.84 / $2,660.36 per yr) and Jome ($299.78/mo; $1,853.56 / $2,337.31+) — confirm current assessments before contracting.
 Classic-collection sq ft ranges (e.g., Blairmore 2,343–3,172; Del Ray 3,022–3,777) reflect optional bonus rooms / second-floor options; DWH lists all eight Classic plans as one story and warns square footage 'may vary based on bonus rooms and options selected.'
 Construction specifics — block vs. frame, impact-rated glass, finished-floor elevation, flood zone, included-features list, lot premiums — are not published on DWH's SeaFlower pages; get them in writing.
 Preferred lender Grace Home Lending is 75% owned by David Weekley Homes; using it is not required, and DWH's FAQ says preferred-lender 'special incentives' may exist — compare terms with an outside lender.

# Cardel Homes at SeaFlower: Plans, Prices, Lot Sizes and Incentives (Sept 2026)

 Cardel Homes at SeaFlower: plans, prices and what to know before you sign 

 Cardel Homes builds Cottage and Classic single-family, natural gas, ADU options in SeaFlower, from the $500s.
 19 floor plans on 50' and 60' lots, 1,909–3,122 square feet, 3–5 bedrooms, 2 quick move-in homes listed. Sales office at 4521 Flower Fields Trail (Daybreak model). Verified Sep 3, 2026.

 Trent’s take

 Trent's take
 Cardel is the design-forward builder here, and the one that took the coastal-village brief most literally: front-garage and rear-garage versions of most plans, natural gas, and garage suites that add roughly 800 square feet on many models. I walked every Cardel model on camera; realistically you are shopping $700,000 to $1.2 million once you add the lot and the options people actually pick, even though base prices start lower. Cardel runs design-option promotions in cash amounts rather than rate buydowns, which suits buyers paying cash or bringing their own lender. Build times are longer than the production builders, so ask for the construction schedule in writing.

 Before your first visit
 If you plan to visit a model, tell me first. Builders register the agent who introduces you, and some will not let you add representation after a first unaccompanied visit. A five-minute call protects your options; it costs nothing.

 Trent's take
 Published incentives are the floor. The real conversation is about lot premium, closing-cost credits tied to the lender, design-center credits and structural options, and it happens with the sales manager, not the website. Timing matters: builders push hardest at the end of their fiscal quarters.

 Fees as quoted by the builder

 Item As quoted 
 HOA (as quoted by builder) $300.88/month for single-family per the Dec 8, 2025 '2026 SeaFlower HOA and CDD Information Sheet' (community-level; Cardel publishes no figure). Cardel states 'Full yard landscape maintenance and internet are included in the HOA.' Covers common areas, parks, trails and landscaping, 1 Gig fiber internet to each home, front and rear yard landscape maintenance, and The Garden Club clubhouse (clubhouse assessment abated until construction is substantially complete). Line items: Common Area Operating $62.90 + Single Family Landscaping $151.67 + Clubhouse $46.31 + Internet $40.00. Billed monthly through ICON Management Services Florida. Townhome $308.43; Villa $327.70. 
 CDD (as quoted by builder) Lake Flores Community Development District (est. Jan 11, 2022; manager Wrathell, Hunt and Associates, 877-276-0889). FY2026 adopted total annual assessment per unit (O&M + debt service): Phase 1B1 SF 50' $4,108.34 / SF 60' $4,849.55 (or $2,014.81 / $2,337.31 where the Series 2023A-2 portion was prepaid); Phase 1B2 SF 50' $3,905.03 / SF 60' $4,611.21; Phase 1C $29.00 (no bonds yet). FY2027 proposed: Phase 1B1 SF 50' $2,011.00 / SF 60' $2,333.50; Phase 1B2 SF 50' $2,279.75 / SF 60' $2,656.01; Phase 1C (Series 2026 bonds) SF 50' $3,899.09 / SF 60' $4,604.78. O&M portion roughly $370–$402/yr. Which phase/bond series covers Cardel's Merritt Ave, Highgrove Ave and Flower Fields Trail lots is unverified. 
 Tax rate (as quoted) unverified 

 Cardel does not publish HOA or CDD dollar figures; all fee numbers are community-level. HOA capital contribution / working-capital fee at closing not listed on the Dec 2025 sheet (unverified). The HOA budget is described as 'conceptual and subject to further refinements', reflects full Phase 1 build-out, and the HOA has not elected statutory reserves. The FY2027 CDD budget was proposed but not yet posted as adopted as of 2026-09-03; the Phase 1B1 drop from FY2026 reflects a partial release of Series 2023A-2 assessments. Full HOA and CDD tables by phase and lot are on the costs and fees page .

 Warranty, lender, design center and construction

 Program Details 
 Warranty '2 year systems and 10 year limited warranty' per the plan specification sheets. A 1-year workmanship term appeared only in search snippets and is unverified. 
 Energy / construction R-38 fiberglass ceiling insulation; R-4.2 Alfoil block insulation; high-efficiency HVAC with programmable thermostat; insulated ductwork; energy-efficient natural-gas tankless water heater; LED lighting; PEX supply lines; whole-house impact-resistant windows. No HERS score or energy certification is stated. 
 Structure Masonry block wall construction with engineered poured concrete cells and steel reinforcement; structurally engineered roof trusses secured with high-strength galvanized-steel hurricane straps; stucco with raised batten details on the front; fully-sealed vapor barrier under a reinforced concrete slab; termite treatment; whole-house impact-resistant windows; 8' fiberglass entry door; raised 8' interior doors; 8' garage doors with openers and floor coating. 
 ADU / casita option Cardel has the deepest garage-apartment menu at SeaFlower. The plan list flags 'OPTIONAL ABOVE GARAGE APARTMENT' on ten plans: Bora, Westerly, Bali, Sea Breeze, Tradewind, Cove 2.0, Crescent, Daybreak, Eventide and Sunrise. A '+800 SQFT' figure is shown on Westerly, Bali, Crescent, Daybreak, Eventide and Sunrise; Bora, Sea Breeze and Tradewind show 'Optional Upper Garage Suite' with no square-footage figure; Cove 2.0's own plan page lists no garage-suite option. Palma (60' front garage) instead offers an 'OPTIONAL FIRST-FLOOR APARTMENT' suite with its own entrance (built in the model with living room and kitchenette). The Bali model is built with a one-bedroom suite above its three-car garage. SeaFlower received ADU ('granny flat') zoning in 2015; developer rules require the owner to live in the primary residence for one year before renting the ADU, with a six-month minimum lease. 
 Design center Cardel Design Center, 3160 South Falkenburg Road, Riverview, FL 33578: 2,400 sq ft boutique-style showroom, by appointment only, 813-612-8001. The visit 'generally happens within approximately three weeks' of purchase; homeowners typically spend '10-20% of the base price of the home' on selections; no structural changes after contract; all flooring, countertops and cabinets must be purchased and installed through Cardel. 
 Affiliated lender Hancock Whitney, named in Cardel's Florida FAQ as 'a preferred lender of Cardel Homes Florida'; construction loans accepted through them; cash buyers follow a draw schedule. No preferred title company requirement was found. Any Cardel rate-buydown promo requires a Cardel preferred lender, but that promo is not offered at SeaFlower. 
 Build timeline 'It can take between 9-14 months' from signed agreement, depending on community (Cardel Florida FAQ). Reserve a homesite with a $5,000 lot deposit, mortgage pre-approval and driver's license(s). 

 What stands out
 Natural gas standard: 30" gas range and tankless gas water heater
 Whole-house impact-resistant windows
 Concrete block with poured, steel-reinforced cells and hurricane-strapped trusses
 Optional above-garage apartment (+800 sq ft where shown) on rear-garage plans
 Front- or alley-load garages at both 50' and 60' widths; 3-car option on rear plans
 42" Level 3 maple cabinets, Whirlpool stainless appliances, Moen Brantford faucets
 Raised 8' interior doors, Cat 6 wiring, 200-amp service
 Craftsman, Coastal and Transitional Farmhouse elevations; pool-ready homesites

 Watch-outs

 Three different incentive statements appear on Cardel's own pages ($25K flex dollars on the QMI page, $20K toward design options on the community page, 'contact a consultant' on the promos page); the $25K expires Sept 30, 2026 and cannot be combined, and the rate buydown is explicitly not offered at SeaFlower. Pin down in writing which applies to a to-be-built contract.
 Base prices exclude lot premiums, options and design-center selections; Cardel says buyers typically spend 10–20% of base on selections, and the two Coral specs are priced roughly $125K–$140K above the $598,990 Coral base.
 Cardel never labels plans as one- or two-story; story counts here are inferred from floor-plan tabs, and Tradewind, Sunrise and Cove 2.0 are the least certain. Cove 2.0 carries the garage-apartment badge on the list page but no suite option on its plan page.
 Annual CDD assessments for 50'/60' lots range from about $2,011 to $4,850 depending on phase and bond series, and which Lake Flores CDD phase covers Cardel's streets is unverified; ask for the exact lot's assessment before contract.
 The ADU is not a short-term rental play: developer rules require one year of owner-occupancy before renting and a six-month minimum lease, and Bora, Sea Breeze and Tradewind publish no square footage for their optional suite.

 Schools as listed by the builder

 Not listed on the builder's page. See the location guide for zoned schools.

 Builders disagree on the middle school. Confirm the assigned zone for a specific address with the Manatee County School District locator before you rely on it. IMG Academy is adjacent to the community.

URL: https://buyinginseaflower.com/builders/issa-homes/
Issa Homes at SeaFlower, Bradenton: Estate Homes starting from $1,250,000, excluding homesite premium. 13 floor plans, 2,905–3,755 sq ft, 2 quick move-ins, model address, fees as quoted, incentives and watch-outs from a former builder insider.

 Issa Homes

 Builder profile · Estate tier

 Issa Homes at SeaFlower: plans, prices and what to know before you sign 

 Issa Homes builds Estate homes on lakefront lots in SeaFlower, from $1,250,000, excluding homesite premium.
 13 floor plans on 80' lots, 2,905–3,474+ square feet, 3–4 (5 with garage apartment) bedrooms, 2 quick move-in homes listed. Sales office at SeaFlower Welcome Center, 4505 Flower Fields Trail (Hemingway model: 4515 Westlake Street). Verified Sep 3, 2026.

 Trent’s take

 Trent's take
 Issa builds the estate tier: 80-foot lakefront lots on Lake Flores, semi-custom plans in the Lakeshore and Preserve collections, and a Hemingway model that won Best Overall at the 2026 Suncoast Parade of Homes. Read the pricing carefully. "From $1,250,000" excludes the homesite premium, and on a lakefront lot the premium is a real number that is only quoted on request. The two quick move-ins on Lake Flores Avenue are listed above $1.5 million. This is a longer build with a different deposit and draw structure than the production builders; get the contract reviewed before you sign it, not after.

 Base prices as published by Issa Homes on Sep 3, 2026. They exclude the lot premium, structural options and design selections. Square footage can vary by elevation and options.

 Before your first visit
 If you plan to visit a model, tell me first. Builders register the agent who introduces you, and some will not let you add representation after a first unaccompanied visit. A five-minute call protects your options; it costs nothing.

 Incentives and promotions

 No incentive is currently published by the builder for SeaFlower. That does not mean nothing is available; it means it is negotiated on site.

 Trent's take
 Published incentives are the floor. The real conversation is about lot premium, closing-cost credits tied to the lender, design-center credits and structural options, and it happens with the sales manager, not the website. Timing matters: builders push hardest at the end of their fiscal quarters.

 Fees as quoted by the builder

 Item As quoted 
 HOA (as quoted by builder) "$299/monthly HOA" (ICON Management; "HOA fee includes Maintenance Grounds") on both Issa MLS listings. Developer's 2026 SeaFlower HOA and CDD Information Sheet (12/8/25): Single Family $300.88 per month, managed by ICON Management Services Florida, including 1 Gig fiber internet and front and rear yard landscape maintenance; the amenity center (clubhouse) assessment is abated until construction is substantially completed. 
 CDD (as quoted by builder) Lake Flores Community Development District (Manatee County Ordinance 22-04; manager Wrathell, Hunt and Associates, (877) 276-0889), collected on the Manatee County tax bill. Developer info sheet for Estate Homes (80'): $2,580.03 debt + $402.29 O&M = $2,982.32 per year. FY2026 adopted budget, SF 80' lots: Phase 1B1 $6,331.97 per unit ($402.29 O&M + $2,580.03 Series 2023A-1 + $3,349.66 Series 2023A-2) on 18 lots, or $2,982.32 on the 3 lots where the 2023A-2 portion was prepaid; Phase 1B2 $6,023.57 per unit. FY2027 proposed (public hearing Aug 17 2026): Phase 1B1 $2,978.51 ($398.48 O&M + $2,580.03 debt); Phase 1B2 $3,408.52 ($398.48 + $3,010.04). Early-payment discounts up to 4%. 
 Tax rate (as quoted) unverified 

 Jome shows CDD fees of 0 for the Issa listings — a data gap, not evidence of no CDD (Jome displays a CDD for David Weekley's SeaFlower listings). Whether Issa lots sit in a separate HOA sub-association is unverified; Pulte's Jome listing shows $899.34 quarterly under Castle Management Group. CDD covers storm water management, wetlands and conservation areas, the multi-modal trail, alleys and streetlights. Full HOA and CDD tables by phase and lot are on the costs and fees page .

 Warranty, lender, design center and construction

 Program Details 
 Warranty "Our warranty covers 1 year on materials and workmanship and 2 years on roofing, plumbing, electrical and HVAC including a 10-year structural component warranty as outlined in the RWC warranty booklet." (RWC = Residential Warranty Company, third-party). Buyers receive a binder with warranty/instruction manuals, Certificate of Occupancy, termite soil treatment records, final survey and the RWC Structural Warranty booklet. 
 Energy / construction "ENERGY STAR Certified" and "Green Construction" per MLS data; "Spray foam insulation" and "Whole-house dehumidification system" (Preserve post, Aug 2026); on-demand natural gas water heater; impact-rated windows and doors ("PGT impact-rated windows and sliding glass doors" per the Preserve post); "smart technology features and energy-conscious materials" (Michael Saunders) 
 Structure Concrete block, slab foundation, shingle roofing with gutters (MLS data); spray foam insulation; whole-house dehumidification system; hurricane-rated roof shingles; impact-rated windows and doors; insulated hurricane-rated steel garage doors; interlocking brick paver driveways, walkways and covered rear porch 
 ADU / casita option Garage apartment (ADU) option on the 2-story Flagler and Key West, adding a 5th bedroom and bath (Flagler – Garage Apartment 4,523 sq ft A/C / 5,818 total; Key West – Garage Apartment 4,503 / 5,798). "Attached 1-bedroom casita (per plan)" on the features page; casita named as an option for Addison and Kingston in the Mar 2025 release. 
 Design center No dedicated design center. Corporate process: Phase 1 pre-construction plan review and modifications, then permitting; Phase 2 selections during the permitting phase (cabinetry, flooring, bath tile, exterior colors/materials, ceiling details, pool finishes) with a partner designer; Phase 3 construction with a framing walk-through before drywall and an online portal with progress photos; Phase 4 warranty orientation. For SeaFlower, Erin of Bee Designed Interiors ("Luxury Design Visionary for SeaFlower") leads the model, spec homes and "the full buyer selection experience"; the corporate page names Soco Interiors, so which firm handles SeaFlower buyer selections is unverified. "Curated upgrade packages for finishes and selections" (Mar 2025 release). 
 Affiliated lender No preferred-lender or preferred-title requirement published on any Issa, Michael Saunders or listing page as of Sep 3 2026 (unverified beyond those pages) 
 Build timeline Not published by the builder. Observed: spec homes listed 03/11/2026 carry "Ready by February 2027" and "Ready by March 2027" completion targets; the model permit was issued June 2025 and the model was open by the Feb 2026 Parade of Homes; sales began in early June 2025 with a model, two spec homes and lot releases. 

 What stands out
 Impact-rated windows and doors (PGT per the Preserve post)
 Vaulted or 12-foot ceilings in living areas; 8-foot solid-core doors
 GE Café or Bosch appliances with 36" gas cooktop
 42" upper cabinets, crown molding, dovetail drawers, plywood box construction
 Kohler plumbing fixtures; on-demand natural gas water heater
 Spray foam insulation and whole-house dehumidification
 Oversized garages with golf-cart storage; paver driveways and covered rear porch
 "Customized structural changes available (per builder's discretion)"

 Watch-outs

 Three different "from" prices are live at once: the microsite headers say "starting from $1,250,000", the estate-homes body says "base price starts at $1.3 million", the features page says "$1.29 million", and the Parade listing says "From the Low $1,300,000s" — all excluding homesite premium.
 Homesite premiums are excluded from every quoted price and are disclosed only on request (the Jan 2026 "Premiums Brochure" is an image-only site map with no dollar figures).
 Spec pricing has moved fast: 7808 Lake Flores Ave (Amelia) was raised to $1,390,000 on Apr 6 2026 (+3.0%, implying about $1,350,000 at its Mar 11 listing) and to $1,567,560 on Aug 10 2026 (+12.77%), roughly 16% in five months; both specs sit well above the advertised base.
 Lake Flores CDD applies to Issa's 80-foot lots even though Jome shows $0: about $2,978–$3,409 per year under the FY2027 proposed budget, and up to $6,332 per year where Series 2023A-2 debt was not prepaid at closing — confirm which tier applies to your lot.
 Plan lineup is in flux: Kingston is named in the intro text but has no plan card; Palm Beach and Sanibel are "Coming Soon" with no specs; Hatteras and the Hemingway 3-car share identical square footage with an unexplained relationship.

 Sea Breeze Elementary (~1.2 mi) — per Jome listing data for 7804 Lake Flores Ave
 "Just For Girls Middle School" (~1.5 mi) — per Jome; verifier flags this as a likely data error (it is a charter academy)
 Bayshore High School (~2.9 mi) — per Jome
 Manatee County School District — official attendance zones unverified; check the Manatee County Schools locator before relying on this

 Builders disagree on the middle school. Confirm the assigned zone for a specific address with the Manatee County School District locator before you rely on it. IMG Academy is adjacent to the community.

 0:24 Quick move-in homes are where the best deals. Builders carry real cost on completed spec inventory t 

 What "base price" leaves out

 Lot premium. Quoted separately, often $10,000 to $80,000 and more on lake or park lots. Same plan, different street, different number.
 Structural options. Extra garage bay, extended lanai, bonus room, pool bath, ADU or garage suite. Chosen before the slab is poured.
 Design selections. Cabinets, counters, flooring, lighting, tile. Base spec is livable; most buyers spend 5% to 15% of base price here.
 Elevation. Some exterior styles cost more. Ask which elevation the base price assumes.
 Closing costs and prepaid items. Typically 2% to 3% of price before builder credits, plus escrow for taxes and insurance.

 Trent’s take
 Quick move-in homes have the options already in them, so their price is closer to the real number. To-be-built homes look cheaper on the sign and rarely stay that way. When I compare a $585,000 quick move-in to a $486,000 base-price plan, I add the lot, the options the inventory home already has, and the timeline before I call one of them the better deal.

# SeaFlower HOA Fees, Lake Flores CDD, Taxes and Insurance: The Real Monthly Cost

URL: https://buyinginseaflower.com/costs/
SeaFlower's HOA is $300.88 a month for single-family homes and includes fiber and yard care; the Lake Flores CDD runs about $1,475 to $4,605 a year by phase and lot width. Worked monthly examples, official CDD tables, tax and insurance math, verified Sept 2026.

Home 
 Costs & fees

 Costs, HOA, CDD, taxes and insurance

 What a SeaFlower home really costs per month 

 A SeaFlower home carries four recurring costs on top of the mortgage:
 an HOA fee of $300.88 a month for a single-family home ($308.43 townhome, $327.70 villa) that includes 1-Gig fiber and full yard maintenance; a Lake Flores CDD assessment of roughly $1,475 to $4,605 a year depending on your phase and lot width, billed on the tax bill; Manatee County property taxes at about 14.61 mills; and homeowner's insurance. On a $486,000 bungalow with 20% down at 6.5%, that works out to roughly $3,730 a month all-in. Figures verified September 3, 2026.

 Updated September 3, 2026 Sources: Lake Flores CDD budgets, developer HOA sheet, builder pages 

 Independent buyer’s guide, not the developer’s or any builder’s site. Figures are as published on the dates noted and must be verified with the builder. Developer’s official site .

 Five real product types at SeaFlower, using the builders' own base prices and the district's own assessment tables. Change the assumptions and the total moves, but the proportions hold.

 Trent's take
 Builders advertise a monthly payment on quick move-ins using a bought-down rate. That payment is real, but it usually leaves out the CDD, which lands in your escrow the first November. Ask for the payment with taxes at full value, CDD included, and insurance quoted. If the rep cannot produce it, I can.

 HOA: what $300.88 a month buys

 The SeaFlower Homeowners Association is managed by ICON Management. The monthly assessment covers 1-Gig fiber internet to every home, front and rear yard landscape maintenance, the parks and trails, and operation of The Garden Club once it opens. Townhome and villa owners pay a little more because their fee also funds exterior maintenance, insurance and reserves on the shared structures.

 Home type Monthly HOA What is different 
 Single-family home $300.88 Yard maintenance front and back, 1-Gig fiber, common areas, Garden Club 
 Townhome (Row Home) $308.43 Adds exterior maintenance, insurance and reserves 
 Twin villa (Village Home) $327.70 Adds exterior maintenance, insurance and reserves 

 Two things to know. First, the clubhouse portion of the assessment is currently abated; it gets added when The Garden Club is substantially complete, which is scheduled for fall 2026, so the fee will step up. Second, the developer's information sheet calls the budget "conceptual" and the figures "good faith estimates." Ask for the current adopted HOA budget, the CC&Rs and any capital contribution or transfer fee before contract; the capital contribution is not published.

 Trent’s take
 Compare apples to apples. Some communities quote a $150 HOA and then charge you $100 a month for internet and $150 for lawn care. SeaFlower bundles both. When buyers compare it to Lakewood Ranch villages, I make them add the lawn and fiber back in before they decide which is cheaper.

 CDD: the line item out-of-state buyers miss

 A Community Development District is a special-purpose government that sells tax-exempt bonds to build a community's infrastructure and pays them back through an annual assessment on each lot. At SeaFlower the district is the Lake Flores Community Development District , created by Manatee County in January 2022 and managed by Wrathell, Hunt and Associates. It paid for stormwater management, the wetlands and conservation areas, the multi-modal trail, the alleys and the streetlights.

 Your assessment has two parts: debt service on the bonds for your phase, and an operations-and-maintenance charge (about $400 a year). It shows up as a non-ad valorem line on your Manatee County tax bill every November, with up to a 4% discount for paying early. Because the debt is fixed to the lot, it does not go up with your home's value, and it can be prepaid in a lump sum.

 The number depends on which phase your lot is in and how wide it is. Phase 1C lots carry the Series 2026 bonds, which is why they are noticeably higher than Phase 1B lots of the same width.

 0:32 Florida CDD Explained The Secret Tax You Need to Know! 

 The disclosures you will sign
 Florida law requires the CDD disclosure in bold type in your purchase contract (Fla. Stat. 190.048) and an HOA disclosure summary before you sign (Fla. Stat. 720.401), with a three-day right to cancel if it is missing. Read both; they are the most honest documents in the package.

 Property taxes

 The tax district covering SeaFlower (Cedar Hammock Fire Control District, unincorporated Manatee County) adopted a total rate of 14.6100 mills for 2025; David Weekley's pages show 14.671, which is the 2024 rate. That is about $1,461 per $100,000 of taxable value . A Florida homestead exemption removes up to $50,000 of assessed value on your primary residence and caps future assessment increases at 3% a year.

 Two new-construction quirks. If your home was not finished on January 1, your first bill is usually based on the land only, and the following year jumps to the full value; your lender's escrow estimate should already assume the full value, so check it. And you must own and occupy by January 1, then file for homestead by March 1, to get the exemption that year. Buyers closing in December and buyers closing in January live in very different tax years.

 Trent’s take
 The single most common budgeting mistake I see: the buyer takes the first year's tax bill on a quick move-in home, which was assessed as dirt, and assumes that is the number. Use the full purchase price times 1.467%, minus the homestead savings, and you will not be surprised in year two.

 Insurance

 Every SeaFlower builder is building to the current Florida Building Code, and the developer's materials describe impact glass or shutters, reinforced block first floors and underground utilities. New construction earns wind-mitigation credits that older homes cannot, so premiums are typically well below the numbers people read about for 1980s houses near the coast. Budget roughly $2,500 to $7,000 a year for a single-family home depending on coverage, elevation and features, and get a real quote from an agent before you go under contract; it is a contingency worth writing in.

 Flood insurance depends on the lot's FEMA zone. FEMA's flood hazard layer shows the interior of SeaFlower as Zone X (minimal hazard), with coastal AE and VE zones west of 86th Street and small Zone A pockets near 75th Street. Lenders do not require flood coverage in Zone X, but a Zone X policy is inexpensive and worth pricing three miles from the Gulf. Confirm your specific lot on Manatee County's flood map.

 One-time costs people forget

 Earnest money and builder deposits. Builders typically ask for a deposit at contract (often a percentage of the base price on a to-be-built home) plus deposits on design selections. These are negotiable in amount and, more importantly, in what happens to them if financing falls through. Read the default clause.
 Lot premiums. Lake, park, corner and oversize lots carry premiums that are quoted separately from the base price. The same plan can differ by tens of thousands of dollars across the street.
 Design center and structural options. Base price buys the base specification. Structural options must be chosen before the slab; finishes come later. This is where budgets drift.
 Closing costs. Roughly 2% to 3% of price for a financed purchase, before any builder credit. Most SeaFlower builders tie their biggest closing-cost credits and rate buydowns to their affiliated lender; you are never required to use that lender, and the math should be run both ways.
 CDD is not an upfront cost. Unlike an impact fee, the district debt is already spread across the annual assessment. You can prepay it later if you want a lower tax bill.

 Cost questions, answered

 Does SeaFlower have a CDD? Yes. SeaFlower sits in the Lake Flores Community Development District, created by Manatee County in January 2022. The annual assessment ranges from about $1,475 for a townhome to about $4,605 for a 60-foot lot in Phase 1C, based on the FY2027 proposed budget, and it is billed on your property-tax bill.

 How much is the HOA at SeaFlower? $300.88 a month for a single-family home, $308.43 for a townhome and $327.70 for a twin villa, per the developer's December 2025 information sheet and David Weekley's community pages. The fee includes 1-Gig fiber internet and front and rear yard maintenance. The clubhouse portion is abated until The Garden Club opens.

 What is the property-tax rate at SeaFlower? About 14.61 mills for 2025 in the Cedar Hammock Fire Control District that covers west Bradenton (David Weekley's pages show 14.671, the 2024 rate), or roughly $1,461 per $100,000 of taxable value before the homestead exemption. Confirm with the Manatee County Property Appraiser.

 Is the CDD fee the same for every home? No. It depends on the phase and lot width. In the FY2027 proposed budget a 50-foot lot is $2,011 in Phase 1B1, $2,280 in Phase 1B2 and $3,899 in Phase 1C. Ask the builder which phase your lot is in.

 Can I prepay the CDD? Yes. The bond portion is attached to the lot and can be paid off in a lump sum, which removes the debt-service part of the annual assessment. The operations-and-maintenance portion continues. Ask the district manager, Wrathell, Hunt and Associates, for a payoff figure.
